property_summary: For any fuzzed vaultIndexDelta and initialUtilIndex, when rate(...) is called with block.timestamp <= stored lastUpdate, the reference implementation always returns a value computed using IVault.utilization(...) (and thus does not depend on currentUtilizationIndex), whereas the mutant may instead read currentUtilizationIndex and so can return a different latestAnswer when currentUtilizationIndex differs from the stored index (i.e., when currentUtilizationIndex != utilizationData.index); the test fuzzes values to find such a difference.
change_summary: When not in the > lastUpdate branch, call currentUtilizationIndex and use it for utilization instead of IVault.utilization, altering returned value.
